elements.description: One composer with every control a running agent needs – stop, resume, retry, steer, queue, mode, permissions, context.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: A heading for the card; empty (the default) leaves the header out

properties.name: state
properties.description: Where the run is. Changed by the controls unless tc-state-change is prevented

properties.name: mode
properties.description: Chat or Act. Changed by the toggle unless tc-mode-change is prevented

properties.name: permission
properties.description: What the agent may do without asking. Changed by the select unless tc-permission-change is prevented

properties.name: queue
properties.description: The asks waiting to go out, in order. Changed by Queue and the chips unless tc-queue-change is prevented

properties.name: context
properties.description: How full the context window is, 0–1; unset hides the ring

properties.name: partial
properties.description: How many characters of the answer have arrived – Resume carries on from here

properties.name: labels
properties.description: The words it uses, merged over the defaults

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-send
events.description: Send was pressed ({ text }: RunControlsSend); cancelable – prevented, the text stays and the state doesn't change

events.name: tc-steer
events.description: A steering note was sent while it answers ({ note }: RunControlsSteer); cancelable – prevented, the note stays

events.name: tc-stop
events.description: Stop was pressed ({ partial }: RunControlsStop); cancelable – prevented, the state stays

events.name: tc-resume
events.description: Resume was pressed ({ from }: RunControlsResume); cancelable – prevented, the state stays

events.name: tc-retry
events.description: Retry was pressed (detail: {}); cancelable – prevented, the state stays

events.name: tc-dismiss
events.description: Dismiss was pressed (detail: {}); cancelable – prevented, the state stays

events.name: tc-state-change
events.description: The state is about to change ({ state }: RunControlsStateChange); cancelable – prevented, `state` stays as it was

events.name: tc-mode-change
events.description: Chat or Act was chosen ({ mode }: RunControlsModeChange); cancelable – prevented, `mode` stays as it was

events.name: tc-permission-change
events.description: A permission was chosen ({ permission }: RunControlsPermissionChange); cancelable – prevented, `permission` stays as it was

events.name: tc-queue-change
events.description: An ask was queued or removed ({ queue }: RunControlsQueueChange); cancelable – prevented, `queue` stays as it was

props.name: title
props.description: A heading for the card; "" (the default) leaves the header out

props.name: state
props.description: Where the run is – controlled when given

props.name: defaultState
props.description: Where the run is at first, when `state` isn't controlled

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: The controls moved the run to another state

props.name: mode
props.description: Chat or Act – controlled when given

props.name: defaultMode
props.description: The mode at first, when `mode` isn't controlled

props.name: permission
props.description: What the agent may do without asking – controlled when given

props.name: defaultPermission
props.description: The permission at first, when `permission` isn't controlled

props.name: queue
props.description: The queued asks – controlled when given

props.name: defaultQueue
props.description: The queued asks at first, when `queue` isn't controlled

props.name: onQueueChange
props.description: An ask was queued or removed

props.name: onSend
props.description: Send was pressed; return false to keep the text and the state

props.name: onSteer
props.description: A steering note was sent; return false to keep it in the field

props.name: onStop
props.description: Stop was pressed, with how much of the answer had arrived

props.name: onResume
props.description: Resume was pressed: carry on from this many characters in

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: :has()
features.why: Layout and state that depend on what's inside a part (an icon present, a focused field).

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: field-sizing
features.without: Text fields grow with their text. Without it they keep their minimum height and scroll.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
